links.comparator_used: Fully manual contouring by the observers (automatic-only contours were also compared against manual)
links.outcome: Inter-observer variability (DSC) and contouring time for CTVs/OARs
links.effect: Inter-observer DSC for automatic + editing vs manual: seminal vesicles 0.83 vs 0.73; prostate 0.86 vs 0.83; rectum 0.96 vs 0.81. Editing improved DSC vs manual to 0.76-0.94. Contouring time fell from 17-24 min (manual) to 3-7 min (editing) for the two observers (p < 0.01).
links.tradeoff: Automatic contours needed some editing: median clinical score 4 (little editing), and score <4 in 3 and 2 patients for the two observers.
links.quote: Inter-observer variability of automatic + editing contours improved significantly, being lower than manual contouring (e.g.: seminal vesicles: 0.83vs0.73; prostate: 0.86vs0.83; rectum: 0.96vs0.81).
